description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling command configurations and plugin integrations related to channels and native commands within a larger application. It includes functions for resolving default settings, enabling/disabling commands, and identifying command flags.

methods.description: Checks if native commands are enabled for a given provider, considering provider and global settings.

methods.description: Internal helper that resolves the effective setting for native commands or skills based on provider and global settings, defaults if unspecified.
